2026-10-18.summary:
### Combat Audio
- Headshot sound now matches the actual direction, fixing reversed left/right audio cues.

### Farming & UI
- Seeds planted outside planters now display correct gene information in the UI.

### Vehicle & Animal Transport
- Sheep can now be loaded onto small modules even when also leading a cow.

items.text: Fixed attached grenades visibility delay so grenades appear correctly when attached to a player.
Added a new creative building tier that is invisible and invulnerable but still collidable, useful for area blocking or floating displays.
Improved Warhead Garage Door colliders for more precise movement, fixing related collision issues.
Fixed scarecrow error preventing it from functioning.
Resolved job errors for crabs and jellyfish, restoring their AI behavior.
Fixed animals not attacking players standing next to vehicles.
Fixed bug where joining clients reset server convars (including gamemode settings) to defaults when using C+S.
Made "leading" the default interaction before petting livestock, changing the interaction order for petting.
Resolved pooling issues that could interrupt player actions during mid-turns, ensuring smoother turn transitions.
Fixed tattoo painting so new ink no longer fades unintentionally, improving live tattoo customization.
Implemented a series of dungeon fixes that address various bugs, improving stability and gameplay in the Halloween 2026 update dungeons.

2026-10-16.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Fixed attached grenades visibility delay so grenades appear correctly when attached to a player.

### Building & Structures
- Added a new creative building tier that is invisible and invulnerable but still collidable, useful for area blocking or floating displays.
- Improved Warhead Garage Door colliders for more precise movement, fixing related collision issues.

### NPC & AI
- Fixed scarecrow error preventing it from functioning.
- Resolved job errors for crabs and jellyfish, restoring their AI behavior.
- Fixed animals not attacking players standing next to vehicles.

### Server & Gameplay Settings
- Fixed bug where joining clients reset server convars (including gamemode settings) to defaults when using C+S.
- Made "leading" the default interaction before petting livestock, changing the interaction order for petting.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Resolved pooling issues that could interrupt player actions during mid-turns, ensuring smoother turn transitions.
- Fixed tattoo painting so new ink no longer fades unintentionally, improving live tattoo customization.
- Implemented a series of dungeon fixes that address various bugs, improving stability and gameplay in the Halloween 2026 update dungeons.
